modules.cloud.railwayNote.zh-CN: 使用账号令牌，或工作区令牌及其工作区 ID。智能体使用它运行 Railway CLI（未安装时在首次使用时获取），令牌不会进入提示词。

modules.cloud.netlify.en: Deploys by agents, draft and production.
modules.cloud.netlify.zh-CN: 由智能体部署到草稿及生产环境。

modules.cloud.netlifyNote.en: Create a personal access token in Netlify user settings. The optional project ID selects an existing project; otherwise the CLI uses this checkout. Tokens never enter agent prompts.
modules.cloud.netlifyNote.zh-CN: 在 Netlify 用户设置中创建个人访问令牌。填写可选的项目 ID 可选择现有项目，否则 CLI 使用当前检出目录。令牌不会进入智能体提示词。

modules.cloud.gcloud.en: Deploys by agents: Cloud Run and Cloud Storage.
modules.cloud.gcloud.zh-CN: 由智能体部署到 Cloud Run 和 Cloud Storage。

modules.cloud.gcloudNote.en: Uses your installed gcloud CLI and its sign-in (run `gcloud auth login` first); PandaCode downloads nothing and stores only the project, region and zone.
modules.cloud.gcloudNote.zh-CN: 使用已安装的 gcloud CLI 及其登录（请先运行 `gcloud auth login`）。PandaCode 不会下载任何内容，只保存项目、区域和可用区。

modules.cloud.docker.en: Containers on this machine or any Docker host.
modules.cloud.docker.zh-CN: 在此计算机或其他 Docker 主机上运行容器。

modules.cloud.dockerNote.en: Runs each task in its own container (label or name prefix pandacode) — Docker, Podman, Apple Containers, or the lxc client (LXD/Incus, which uses its own configured remotes; Podman remote hosts take ssh://). For ssh:// and tcp:// hosts, that daemon is root-equivalent — only point at machines you trust. Containers keep their disk until deleted and use this machine’s or the host’s resources; nothing is billed.
modules.cloud.dockerNote.zh-CN: 每个任务在独立容器中运行（标签或名称前缀为 pandacode），支持 Docker、Podman、Apple Containers 或 lxc 客户端（LXD/Incus 使用自身配置的远程主机；Podman 远程主机使用 ssh://）。ssh:// 和 tcp:// 主机的守护进程拥有相当于 root 的权限，请仅连接可信主机。容器使用本机或主机的资源，磁盘保留至删除，不产生云服务账单。

modules.cloud.machines.zh-CN: 供智能体使用的云主机。

modules.cloud.imageHelp.en: New InstaBox machines start from this image. Snapshots are listed once they are ready; to run agents without the desktop tool agent-browser includes, make a snapshot as docs/cloud-agents.md describes.
modules.cloud.imageHelp.zh-CN: 新建 InstaBox 主机将使用此镜像。快照就绪后会显示在列表中。若要在不含 agent-browser 桌面工具的环境中运行智能体，请按照 docs/cloud-agents.md 创建快照。

modules.cloud.claudeHelp.en: Run `claude setup-token` and paste the long-lived token it prints. Without one, PandaCode copies this computer’s Claude Code login to the machine before each run.
modules.cloud.claudeHelp.zh-CN: 运行 `claude setup-token`，粘贴输出的长期令牌。未提供令牌时，PandaCode 会在每次运行前将此计算机的 Claude Code 登录复制到主机。

modules.cloud.inheritHelp.en: When on, cloud agents this provider runs also get the environment variables saved for the harness in Settings → Providers — a proxy the cloud machine can reach, for example. Off by default: nothing is sent to this cloud. Variables that point at this computer (a localhost HTTP_PROXY) are refused when a task starts, because a cloud machine cannot reach them.
modules.cloud.inheritHelp.zh-CN: 开启后，此云服务商运行的智能体会继承设置 → 提供商中保存的运行器环境变量，例如云主机可访问的代理。默认关闭，不向云端发送变量。启动任务时会拒绝指向本机的变量（如 localhost HTTP_PROXY），因为云主机无法访问它们。

modules.cloud.keyAt.en: Create a key at {location}. Cloud agents run on machines in your own account.
modules.cloud.keyAt.zh-CN: 在 {location} 创建密钥。云端智能体将在您账号下的主机上运行。

modules.cloud.imageSaved.zh-CN: 已保存。新主机将使用 {image} 启动。

modules.cloud.pasteToken.en: Paste the token from claude setup-token.
modules.cloud.pasteToken.zh-CN: 请粘贴 claude setup-token 输出的令牌。

modules.cloud.tokenSaved.en: Saved. Cloud agents sign in to Claude with this token.
modules.cloud.tokenSaved.zh-CN: 已保存。云端智能体将使用此令牌登录 Claude。

modules.cloud.inheritSaved.en: Saved. Cloud agents on this provider include the saved environment variables.
modules.cloud.inheritSaved.zh-CN: 已保存。此提供商的云端智能体将继承已保存的环境变量。

modules.cloud.inheritOff.en: Saved. Nothing from the provider environment is sent to this cloud.
modules.cloud.inheritOff.zh-CN: 已保存。不向此云端发送提供商环境变量。

modules.usage.help.en: Reads account limits from your locally configured agent accounts. Requests go directly to the provider or its CLI, never through PandaCode servers. No prompts are sent. Results are cached for one minute; Refresh is limited to once every ten seconds per provider. Some providers do not expose their limits. Usage is shared with other apps using the same account.

modules.usage.readLogsFailed.en: Could not read local agent logs.
modules.usage.readLogsFailed.zh-CN: 无法读取本地智能体日志。

modules.usage.pricesLive.zh-CN: 价格：LiteLLM 公开价目表，更新于 {time}。

modules.usage.costHelp.en: Estimated from token counts in {logs} logs on this computer, read when this window opens. Only counts are kept and nothing is uploaded. Priced at standard API rates (batch, priority, and fast-mode pricing excluded); subscriptions bill differently.

modules.providers.mimo.en: Use your Token Plan (or pay-as-you-go) key with your installed Claude Code. Pick the cluster shown on your Token Plan page; keys look like tp-…, ttp-… or sk-….
modules.providers.mimo.zh-CN: 在已安装的 Claude Code 中使用 Token Plan 或按量付费密钥。请选择 Token Plan 页面上显示的集群；密钥格式为 tp-…、ttp-… 或 sk-…。

modules.providers.opencode.en: Uses the accounts and models configured in OpenCode. Sign in once with opencode auth login.
modules.providers.opencode.zh-CN: 使用 OpenCode 中配置的账号和模型。运行 opencode auth login 登录一次即可。

modules.providers.antigravity.en: Connect the official Google Antigravity ACP server. The standalone agy terminal CLI is a different executable.
modules.providers.antigravity.zh-CN: 连接官方 Google Antigravity ACP 服务器。独立的 agy 终端 CLI 是另一个可执行文件。

modules.providers.grok.en: Uses your Grok sign-in and models. Install with curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash, then run grok login once; PandaCode talks to grok agent stdio.
modules.providers.grok.zh-CN: 使用您的 Grok 登录和模型。运行 curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash 安装，然后运行 grok login 登录一次；PandaCode 通过 grok agent stdio 通信。

modules.providers.omp.en: A Pi fork with its own accounts and models. Install it with bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent, then sign in from the omp CLI before starting a task.
modules.providers.omp.zh-CN: Pi 的一个分支，使用独立的账号和模型。运行 bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent 安装，并在开始任务前通过 omp CLI 登录。

modules.providers.deepseek.en: Install with npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh. A key is optional: DeepSeek can use its own stored credentials.
modules.providers.deepseek.zh-CN: 运行 npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh 安装。密钥可选，DeepSeek 可使用自身保存的凭据。

modules.providers.commandcode.en: Install with npm i -g command-code, then sign in once with command-code login. A key is optional: either one authenticates the same account.
modules.providers.commandcode.zh-CN: 运行 npm i -g command-code 安装，然后运行 command-code login 登录一次。密钥可选，两种方式均用于验证同一账号。

modules.providers.cline.en: Install with npm i -g cline, then sign in once with cline auth (or set CLINE_API_KEY). PandaCode talks to cline --acp and uses the provider and models chosen in Cline.
modules.providers.cline.zh-CN: 运行 npm i -g cline 安装，然后运行 cline auth 登录一次（或设置 CLINE_API_KEY）。PandaCode 通过 cline --acp 通信，并使用 Cline 中选择的提供商和模型。

modules.providers.copilot.en: Install with npm install -g @github/copilot, then run copilot login in a terminal. PandaCode uses the CLI sign-in; GitHub credentials stay with Copilot CLI.
modules.providers.copilot.zh-CN: 运行 npm install -g @github/copilot 安装，然后在终端运行 copilot login。PandaCode 使用 CLI 的登录，GitHub 凭据由 Copilot CLI 保管。

modules.providers.devin.en: Install with curl -fsSL https://cli.devin.ai/install.sh | bash (or brew install --cask devin-cli), then run devin auth login once in a terminal. PandaCode talks to devin acp with that sign-in; the CLI bundled with Devin Desktop works too.
modules.providers.devin.zh-CN: 运行 curl -fsSL https://cli.devin.ai/install.sh | bash 或 brew install --cask devin-cli 安装，然后在终端运行 devin auth login 登录一次。PandaCode 使用该登录通过 devin acp 通信，也支持 Devin Desktop 附带的 CLI。

modules.providers.kilo.en: Install with npm i -g @kilocode/cli, then sign in with kilo auth login. PandaCode talks to kilo acp and uses the accounts and models configured in Kilo.
modules.providers.kilo.zh-CN: 运行 npm i -g @kilocode/cli 安装，然后运行 kilo auth login 登录。PandaCode 通过 kilo acp 通信，使用 Kilo 中配置的账号和模型。

modules.providers.muse.en: Install Muse Code, then run muse login once in a terminal. PandaCode talks to muse serve and uses that sign-in.
modules.providers.muse.zh-CN: 安装 Muse Code，然后在终端运行 muse login 登录一次。PandaCode 通过 muse serve 通信并使用该登录。

modules.providers.hermes.en: Install with curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash, then run hermes acp --setup or configure ~/.hermes/config.yaml. PandaCode talks to hermes acp.
modules.providers.hermes.zh-CN: 运行 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash 安装，然后运行 hermes acp --setup，或配置 ~/.hermes/config.yaml。PandaCode 通过 hermes acp 通信。

modules.providers.zcode.en: Run zcode in a terminal and sign in. PandaCode talks to it over its app-server protocol.
modules.providers.zcode.zh-CN: 在终端运行 zcode 并登录。PandaCode 通过其 app-server 协议通信。

modules.providers.help.en: Each sign-in, key or plan here is used only by the agent it belongs to — the global environment variables are the one thing every harness gets. GLM Coding Plan and MiMo Token Plan run through your installed Claude Code, and you pick them in the model selector. Named connections are extra setups of one agent. PandaCode needs no provider of its own: titles come from the agent running the task, project checks run your own test command, and Jev uses its own keys. Codex, when installed, also lists integrations and imports Codex conversations.
modules.providers.help.zh-CN: 此处的登录、密钥或套餐仅供对应智能体使用，只有全局环境变量会传给所有运行器。GLM Coding Plan 和 MiMo Token Plan 通过已安装的 Claude Code 运行，可在模型选择器中选择。命名连接是同一智能体的额外配置。PandaCode 自身无需提供商：标题由运行任务的智能体生成，项目检查使用您自己的测试命令，Jev 使用独立密钥。安装 Codex 后，还可列出集成并导入 Codex 对话。

modules.providers.claudeHelp.en: Use current environment preserves your existing Claude setup. Prefer saved Claude login removes inherited API credentials, endpoints, and model routing overrides from new Claude processes in PandaCode. Claude settings, credential helpers, profiles, and organization policies can still affect authentication. Check /status in Claude to confirm.
modules.providers.claudeHelp.zh-CN: “使用当前环境”保留现有 Claude 配置。“优先使用已保存的 Claude 登录”会从 PandaCode 新建的 Claude 进程中移除继承的 API 凭据、端点及模型路由覆盖项。Claude 设置、凭据助手、配置和组织策略仍可能影响身份验证。请在 Claude 中运行 /status 确认。

modules.providers.globalEnvironmentHelp.en: These variables are added to every agent harness PandaCode starts — for example HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY behind a proxy. Each provider can leave the global set out in its own card, and provider sign-in and endpoint settings always win. Values are saved on this computer and never shown again.
modules.providers.globalEnvironmentHelp.zh-CN: 这些变量会传给 PandaCode 启动的所有智能体运行器，例如代理环境下的 HTTP_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY 和 NO_PROXY。各提供商可单独禁用全局变量；提供商的登录和端点设置始终优先。变量值保存在本机，保存后不再显示。

modules.providers.environmentHelp.en: These variables are added whenever PandaCode starts this harness — for example HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY behind a proxy. Provider sign-in and endpoint settings always win, and a named connection adds its own environment on top. Values are saved on this computer and never shown again.
modules.providers.environmentHelp.zh-CN: 每次 PandaCode 启动此运行器时都会添加这些变量，例如代理环境下的 HTTP_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY 和 NO_PROXY。提供商登录和端点设置始终优先，命名连接还会叠加自身环境。变量值保存在本机，保存后不再显示。

modules.remote.scopeHelp.en: View only: see tasks, changes and diffs. Control: also send prompts, stop tasks and answer approvals. Full access: also start tasks, merge pull requests and message bots. Blocked: refused.
modules.remote.scopeHelp.zh-CN: 仅查看：查看任务、更改和差异。控制：还可发送提示词、停止任务及回应批准请求。完全访问：还可启动任务、合并拉取请求及向机器人发消息。已屏蔽：拒绝访问。

modules.remote.full_tip.en: When off, your other computers cannot start or switch a task here to Full access (no approvals); a remote task without a mode starts in Ask.
modules.remote.full_tip.zh-CN: 关闭时，其他计算机不能在此处启动或切换至完全访问模式（无需批准）；未指定模式的远程任务会以询问模式启动。

modules.remote.allow_tip.en: Remote prompts follow this computer’s approval settings; they get no more power than prompts typed here.
modules.remote.allow_tip.zh-CN: 远程提示词遵循此计算机的批准设置，不会获得比本地输入更多的权限。

modules.remote.notify_tip.en: The relay sends the phone a push that says only how many tasks need attention; approving still happens in the app over the end-to-end encrypted channel.
modules.remote.notify_tip.zh-CN: 中继向手机发送的推送仅包含需要关注的任务数量；批准操作仍在应用中通过端到端加密通道进行。

modules.remote.key_tip.en: Another computer shows this key when it asks you to approve this one. Approve only if the keys match.
modules.remote.key_tip.zh-CN: 另一台计算机请求您批准此设备时，会显示此密钥。仅在密钥一致时才批准。

modules.remote.code_tip.en: A one-time code skips the approval prompt for one new device. It works once, for 10 minutes, and gives the access you pick. Enter it on the other computer under Pair with a code.
modules.remote.code_tip.zh-CN: 一次性验证码可让一台新设备跳过批准提示。验证码仅可使用一次，有效期 10 分钟，授予您所选的权限。在另一台计算机的“使用验证码配对”中输入。

modules.remote.pair_tip.en: Enter the 6-digit code that the other computer shows under Pairing code. It gives this computer the access that computer chose.
modules.remote.pair_tip.zh-CN: 输入另一台计算机“配对码”下显示的 6 位数字。此计算机将获得对方选择的访问权限。

modules.routing.help.en: Panda Router runs locally. For each worker it predicts which of your installed models is likely to succeed and picks one by your mode. Balanced weighs success against cost; Cheap takes the lowest cost above the minimum chance of success and moves up only if review fails; Best takes the likeliest to succeed. The Team button in the prompt box sets the same mode. The first use downloads a 35 MB profiler from GitHub.
modules.routing.help.zh-CN: Panda Router 在本机运行，预测已安装模型完成各工作智能体任务的成功概率，并按所选模式挑选。均衡模式综合成功率与成本；经济模式选择超过最低成功概率的最便宜模型，仅在审查失败时升级；最佳模式选择最可能成功的模型。输入框中的团队按钮设置同一模式。首次使用会从 GitHub 下载 35 MB 任务分析器。

modules.tiers.help.en: Your tiers weigh most in Panda Router's picks: a ranked model's chance of success is 70% its tier and 30% the router's own rating, so a higher tier is usually tried first. Unranked models keep the router's own rating.
modules.tiers.help.zh-CN: 您的分级是 Panda Router 选择模型的主要依据：已分级模型的成功概率由 70% 的用户分级和 30% 的路由器评分组成，因此通常优先尝试更高等级。未分级模型沿用路由器评分。

modules.tiers.unrated.en: Panda Router has no rating for this model. Ranking it lets the router use it.
modules.tiers.unrated.zh-CN: Panda Router 尚无此模型的评分。为其分级后，路由器即可使用它。
